planets.name: NGTS-11 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of NGTS-11 with a 35.5-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: NGTS-11 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around NGTS-11. Its orbit and size follow Gill et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
